reason: Two completed PRIMARY trials show weak search accuracy: flattened-pixel logistic C0.1 reached 0.39375 with severe overfit (train 1.0), and gradient-histogram logistic reached 0.4 with train 0.7640625. The untried frozen MobileNet-v3-small feature route provides a different representation and a regularized linear classifier, making it the most promising available candidate to test on the primary split without relying on an assumed gain.
review: Evidence is limited to two completed PRIMARY trials and no confirmation split is available. The candidate is untried, so its search accuracy is unknown; prior results do not establish that any route will improve.
hypothesis: Frozen pretrained image features may capture shape and texture information that is poorly represented by flattened standardized pixels, while an L2-normalized 576-dimensional representation with logistic regression may reduce the overfitting seen in trial 1.
uncertainty: Unknown whether ImageNet-pretrained MobileNet-v3-small features transfer well to 64x64 stretched RGB inputs and this five-class training partition. No predicted improvement is claimed; the candidate is selected as an untried representation with plausible regularization benefits.
